unaWebAppPerGestirePrenotazioni: A web app to manage bookings, driver and vehicle assignments and list releases in Dallas and San Antonio. The day's plan changes as new bookings arrive: the team has to track shared departures, passenger counts and vehicle capacity across two cities.
unCalendarioPerPianificareOgni: A calendar to plan every day
laVistaMensileMostraLAttivita: The month view shows activity by date. Opening a day shows its departures and assignments.
leNuovePrenotazioniCompatibili: Eligible new bookings join the assigned driver's list when there's room. Automatic releases follow the configured schedule, and exceptions stay visible for the manager.
preparaEInviaLeListePerITourDel: Prepares and releases lists for the next day's tours.
portaNelPianoLePrenotazioni: Brings overnight booking changes into the plan.
inviaLeModificheDentroLaFinestra: Releases changes within the configured window.
leInformazioniDelTourSulTelefono: Tour information on the driver's phone
gliAutistiVedonoIProssimiTourI: Drivers see upcoming tours, passenger details and released PDFs. They confirm the assignment, so the office knows it's been acknowledged.
schermateEDocumentiUsanoDati: Screens and documents use fictional demo data, including customer and driver details.
statoDeiMessaggiDelleListe: Status of messages, passenger lists and booking sync in a single summary: the team sees what needs attention without opening several systems.
prenotazioniCapienzaNoteTotaliE: Bookings, capacity, notes, totals and alert states in a dense format, to quickly review the coming days and catch problems before they arrive.
statoDeiReportEAccessoSicuroAi: Report status and secure PDF access
statoDeiReportPerDataEProdotto: Report status by date and product: sent, scheduled, failed, stopped and resumed. Generated PDFs open or are shared through short, secure links.
assegnazioniPerDataEProdottoCon: Assignments by date and product, with separate views for vehicle needs, eligibility and chosen contacts. No more scattered notes.
whatsappSmsDiRiservaEAvvisi: WhatsApp, fallback SMS and manual alerts
comunicazioneAiClientiPerDataDi: Customer communication by service date: sent, failed, fallback and pending. Admins can send manual SMS alerts when an urgent update is needed.
perOsservareUnaGiornataServiva: To get a view of the day, the team had to open bookings, chats and spreadsheets, one by one.
unaSolaSchermataMostraTutto: One screen shows everything: bookings, passenger lists, messages and guides.
seUnMessaggioAUnClienteNon: If a message to a customer didn't arrive, the team found out late, often when the customer called.
iMessaggiNonConsegnatiSuWhatsapp: Messages not delivered on WhatsApp are automatically delivered by SMS, and if that fails a notification appears.
leListePasseggeriSiPreparavanoA: Passenger lists were prepared by hand and sent to guides by email or chat.
leListeDiventanoUnPdf: Lists become an auto-filled PDF and are shared automatically, in an orderly way, through a link that deletes itself after 24h.
perAvvisareIClientiDiUnCambio: To warn customers about a last-minute change, someone had to message or call them one by one.
dallaDashboardSiMandaUnSmsAi: An SMS goes out to the customers involved in a few clicks from the dashboard.
qualeGuidaEQualeAutistaSeguivano: Which guide and which driver covered each tour was written in scattered sheets and notes. After the assignment, the most time-consuming part was communicating it.
guideEAutistiSiAssegnanoNel: Guides and drivers are assigned in the calendar, next to the day's bookings, and the driver's screen updates automatically with the information they need.
dashboardPrivataPerTuttoIlTeam: private dashboard for the whole team
finestreDiInvioMonitorateSeraE: monitored send windows, evening and morning
durataDeiLinkSicuriAlleListe: lifetime of secure passenger list links
tuttaLaGiornataDiUnTourOperator: A tour operator's whole day in a single app
prenotazioniCapienzaListe: Bookings, capacity, passenger lists, guides and drivers, WhatsApp and SMS customer messages: all checked by hand in different places. Now the team sees the status of everything and acts from one place.
leCinqueAreeDellApp: The five areas of the app

dueTourOperatorDueMercatiLa: Two tour operators, two markets, the same foundation
prenotazioniPartenzeAutistiGuide: Bookings, departures, drivers, guides, passenger lists and customer messages. A private system built around the workflows you already run, connected to your booking platform.
primaConversazioneSenzaImpegno: First conversation, no strings attached: we look at how you work today.
laGiornataReggeMaSoloPerche: The day works, but only because someone checks everything by hand
iProcessiDiUnTourOperatorDi: A tour operator's processes usually already work. What's missing is visibility: information sits in different places, and the day gets done because someone pieces it together every day.

assegnatiSuFogliDiCalcoloAppunti: assigned in spreadsheets, notes and chats.

cheNessunoVedeFincheNonDiventano: nobody sees until they become a problem.

statoDiPrenotazioniListeE: Status of bookings, lists and messages, urgent alerts and recent activity.
vistaPerGiornoEProdottoCapienza: Daily view by product, capacity, notes and alerts.
assegnazioniCondiviseControllo: Shared assignments, seat checks, scheduled releases.

ogniTourOperatorHaLaSua: Every tour operator has its own booking platform, its own way of handling guides and drivers, its own customer channels. What carries over is the method: connect the daily signals, show status clearly and give the team controlled actions from one private system.
comeGestisciOggiPrenotazioni: How you handle bookings, passenger lists, guides, drivers and customer messages today.
iPassaggiManualiCheCreanoPiu: The manual steps that create the most operational risk or waste the most time.
ilPrimoSistemaUtileAttornoAi: The first useful system, built around the workflows you already run every day.
automazioniEReportSoloDoveFanno: Automation and reports only where they save real time or prevent real mistakes.
quattroPassiPrimaIlTuoFlusso: Four steps, your real workflow first
devoCambiarePiattaformaDi: Do I have to change my booking platform?
noIlSistemaSiCollegaAQuellaChe: No. The system connects to the one you already use: for FunDallas Tours, for example, it reads bookings from FareHarbor. During mapping we check what yours allows.
suMisuraSuUnaBaseGiaCollaudataIn: Custom, on a foundation already proven at two tour operators. You don't adapt to the software: we adapt the modules to your products, vehicles and channels.
autistiEGuidePossonoUsarloDal: Can drivers and guides use it on their phone?
siNelCasoFundallasGliAutisti: Yes. At FunDallas, drivers see assigned tours, passengers and PDFs, and confirm the assignment from their phone.
dipendeDaiModuliCheServono: It depends on the modules you actually need. After the first conversation and the mapping you get a written quote with modules and phases, before any commitment.
siLavoriamoInItaliaENegliStati: Yes. We work in Italy and the United States, in Italian and English: FunDallas Tours operates between Dallas and San Antonio, Texas.
laTuaGiornataOperativaInUnUnica: Your daily operation in one app
unaPrimaConversazionePerMappare: A first conversation to map your workflow and see where a custom system pays off most. If it doesn't make sense for you, we'll say so right away.
rispondiamoInItalianoEInInglese: We reply in English and Italian.
bSpaziSeparatiPerCittaBDallasE: City workspacesDallas and San Antonio each have their own workspace, with the same controls.
bStatoDelDispatchBQualiTourVanno: Dispatch statusWhich tours need an assignment, which lists have been released, which drivers have confirmed.
bDettaglioDellaPartenzaB: Departure detailsBookings, driver and vehicle choice, capacity check.
bAutistaEMezzoCondivisiBTour: Shared driver and vehicleCompatible tours share one assignment; one PDF can cover several departures.
bControlloManualeSemprePossibile: Manual control when neededEdit, check capacity, preview the PDF and release manually.
bPrenotazioniCombinateBOgni: Combination bookingsEach combination booking appears once, with its included tour portions listed together.
bInvioEConfermaTracciatiBOgniPdf: Release and confirmation trackedEach PDF has a version number; release and driver confirmation are tracked separately.
